rules.member_drift: weekday == 6 ? min(max(0, round(courts_open * service_rate + (stat.quality - 30) / 12 + stat.reputation / 30)), courts_open * 12 + (facility.clubhouse == "open" ? 15 : 0) - stat.members) : 0

en.endings.exhibition.title: The exhibition happened
en.endings.exhibition.body: For the first time in ten years, the stands of Stadium 1 were full. Indian Wells is alive again.
en.endings.deadline.title: Time's up
en.endings.deadline.body: The investors' sixteen weeks are over and the exhibition never happened. The restoration stops and the gates are locked again.
en.endings.bankrupt.title: Out of money
en.endings.bankrupt.body: The garden can't make payroll and the investors stop the restoration. The gates are locked again.
en.events.iw_investor_check.title: The investors visit
en.events.iw_investor_check.body: The investors are at the main gate. Three weeks are left before their deadline.
en.events.iw_investor_check.options.B: Have a look on your own
en.events.iw_deadline.title: Time's up
en.events.iw_deadline.body: Sixteen weeks are over. The investors leave a folder on the clubhouse desk.
en.events.iw_arrival.title: The ball machine in the shed
en.events.iw_arrival.body: Dale shows you around. "Ten years, and nobody's hit a ball here." There's an old ball machine in the shed.
en.events.iw_arrival.options.A: Keep it and fix it for the academy later
en.events.iw_arrival.options.B: Sell it for some cash now
en.events.iw_first_players.title: The first visitors
en.events.iw_first_players.body: Two retirees from Palm Desert stand at the gate of Court 1 and ask if they can play.
en.events.iw_sandstorm.title: The wind is up
en.events.iw_sandstorm.body: Sand is pouring onto the outer courts. Dale asks over the radio whether to cover them now.
en.events.iw_sandstorm.options.B: Wait for the wind to stop
en.events.iw_reporter.title: The Desert Sun is here
en.events.iw_reporter.body: A reporter heard someone is restoring the abandoned garden and wants to write a story.
en.events.iw_reporter.options.A: Give him a two-hour tour and lunch
en.events.iw_sponsor.title: The bank's banner
en.events.iw_sponsor.body: A local bank saw Stadium 3 reopen and wants to hang a big banner over the stands. The offer is good.
en.events.iw_dale_story.title: The last tournament
en.events.iw_dale_story.body: The night Stadium 2 reopens, Dale talks about the last tournament before the garden closed. He was in the umpire's chair that year.
en.events.iw_dale_story.options.B: Take a few days off first
en.events.iw_hiring_day_1.title: The first hiring day
en.events.iw_hiring_day_1.body: You put a notice on the clubhouse door and two people came. Anyone you hire is paid weekly.
en.events.iw_hiring_day_2.title: The second hiring day
en.events.iw_hiring_day_2.body: Two weeks later two more came: a coach and a quick, experienced handyman.
en.events.iw_hiring_day_3.title: The third hiring day
en.events.iw_hiring_day_3.body: The garden has a bit of a name now, and the applicants are better.
en.events.iw_hiring_day_4.title: The fourth hiring day
en.events.iw_hiring_day_4.body: A former pro heard about the place and wants to be head coach; a young all-rounder came too.
en.log.started: You arrive at the abandoned Indian Wells Tennis Garden.
en.log.first_court: Court 1 has a new net: the first playable court in ten years
en.log.ball_machine: The ball machine works again; academy lessons are better

en.log.no_hire: No hire this time; the same people do the work

zh.facilities.plaza.open: 广场 · 喷泉又有水了
zh.endings.exhibition.title: 表演赛办成了
zh.endings.exhibition.body: 十年来第一次，Stadium 1 的看台上坐满了人。Indian Wells 又活过来了。
zh.endings.deadline.title: 期限到了
zh.endings.deadline.body: 投资方给的十六周到了，表演赛还没办成。修复停了，大门又锁上了。
zh.endings.bankrupt.title: 钱花光了
zh.endings.bankrupt.body: 园区发不出工资，投资方叫停了修复。大门又锁上了。
zh.events.iw_investor_check.title: 投资方来看进度
zh.events.iw_investor_check.body: 投资方的人站在大门口。离他们给的期限只剩三周了。
zh.events.iw_deadline.title: 期限到了
zh.events.iw_deadline.body: 十六周到了。投资方的人把一份文件放在会所的桌子上。
zh.events.iw_arrival.title: 仓库里的发球机
zh.events.iw_arrival.body: Dale 带你转了一圈。"十年了，没人在这儿打过一个球。"仓库角落里还有一台旧发球机。
zh.events.iw_arrival.options.A: 留着，以后修好给学院用
zh.events.iw_first_players.title: 第一批客人
zh.events.iw_first_players.body: 两位从 Palm Desert 来的退休老人站在外场 1 门口，问能不能打一场。
zh.events.iw_sandstorm.title: 起风了
zh.events.iw_sandstorm.body: 风卷着沙往外场里灌，Dale 在对讲机里喊：要不要现在去把场地盖上？
zh.events.iw_reporter.title: The Desert Sun 来了
zh.events.iw_reporter.body: 一位记者听说有人在修这座废弃的园区，想来写一篇报道。
zh.events.iw_reporter.options.A: 亲自带他转两个小时，请他吃午饭
zh.events.iw_sponsor.title: 银行的横幅
zh.events.iw_sponsor.body: 本地一家银行看到 Stadium 3 开了，想在看台上挂一块大横幅，出价不低。
zh.events.iw_dale_story.title: 最后一届比赛
zh.events.iw_dale_story.body: Stadium 2 修好的那天晚上，Dale 说起园区关门前的最后一届比赛，他那年坐在裁判椅上。
zh.events.iw_dale_story.options.A: 表演赛那天请你坐裁判椅
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_1.title: 第一个招聘日
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_1.body: 会所门口贴了告示，来了两个人。招了就每周付工资。
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_2.title: 第二个招聘日
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_2.body: 两周后又来了两个人：一位教练，一位干活很利索的老师傅。
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_3.title: 第三个招聘日
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_3.body: 园区有点名气了，来的人水平也高了。
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_4.title: 第四个招聘日
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_4.body: 一位前职业球员听说了这里，想来当主教练；还有一个什么都会一点的年轻人。
zh.log.started: 你来到了废弃的 Indian Wells Tennis Garden。
zh.log.first_court: 外场 1 换上了新网：十年来第一块能打的场地
zh.log.ball_machine: 发球机修好了，学院的课更扎实了

zh.log.exhibition_flop: 表演赛冷场了：看台上稀稀拉拉，一周后再试一次
zh.log.no_hire: 这次没招人，活还是那几个人干
